verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair question for a tax-filing platform with a sanctioned software channel, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a single all-purpose ELSTER certificate per registrant, plus adjacent delegation features (mailbox deputies who can view messages, powers of attorney filed with the tax office). None of these is a documented way to issue scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
